title: CodeRabbit joins the SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network
text: CodeRabbit is an authorized partner in the SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network and is now available in the Grok Build Plugin Marketplace. As autonomous coding agents generate an increasing volume of pull requests, engineering teams face new demands to verify code quality, mitigate security risks, and understand broader system impacts before shipping. Meeting those demands requires governance and control that keep pace with agentic development. The partnership enables customers to connect development in Grok Build with CodeRabbit’s [Agentic Change Management](https://www.coderabbit.ai/blog/introducing-agentic-change-management) platform. CodeRabbit reviews code from developers and AI agents, explains how each change affects the codebase, prioritizes human attention, and investigates security vulnerabilities in new and existing code. Bringing these capabilities into everyday development gives teams a clearer path from generated code to software they can ship and maintain with confidence. > We want our customers to have optionality, and that’s why we’re proud to announce that CodeRabbit is now available in the Grok Build Plugin Marketplace. Code review often stops at the diff. CodeRabbit’s [Agentic Change Management](https://www.coderabbit.ai/blog/introducing-agentic-change-management) platform helps teams govern software change before and after merge. That’s exactly the independent control layer our customers need as they build with AI at scale. — Toni Adams, SVP of Partnerships, SpaceXSI ## How teams ship trustworthy software with Grok Build and CodeRabbit Engineering teams of all sizes pair Grok Build and CodeRabbit to ship trustworthy software at agentic speed. ### Dub [Dub’s five-person team](https://www.coderabbit.ai/case-studies/small-startup-big-ambitions-how-codeRabbit-helped-dub-reach-10M-in-partner-payouts) builds software that handles partner payments. Founder and CEO Steven Tey uses Grok Build for code generation and CodeRabbit as the trust and governance layer for the code they ship. Tey sees the tools as complementary and considers CodeRabbit the final layer of defense before anything goes into production. Dub's approach to managing risk at this scale starts with scoping. Rather than shipping sprawling features all at once, the team builds v1 releases, ships, learns, and follows with v2. CodeRabbit reinforced that discipline at the code level. Tey estimates that CodeRabbit made code reviews 100% to 150% more efficient. Without it, he says the same review would require two to three times the effort. Dub crossed $10 million in partner payouts in December 2025, six months after launching its partner management product. Every pull request for that product passed through CodeRabbit review. Tey says clean code is essential as Dub scales. “CodeRabbit is pretty good at making sure that the way we write code is efficient and without any security issues.” ## Build with Grok Build and govern changes with CodeRabbit Grok Build helps developers implement changes, while CodeRabbit independently reviews those changes against repository context and organizational standards. Teams can review pull requests on the web or use CodeRabbit in their IDE or CLI. Developers can address findings while the context is fresh and use their judgment to decide what ships. [Try CodeRabbit](https://app.coderabbit.ai) on your next Grok Build change and let us know how the workflow holds up.
